ws = wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in wb.sheetnames else wb.active

min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_position)

def is_blank(v):
    return v is None or (isinstance(v, str) and v == "")

# For each row in the target answer range, fill Column B with the nearest
# non-blank value from Column A at or above that row (forward fill).
last_non_blank = None

# First establish any carry-forward value above the answer range, if present.

    if not is_blank(v):
        last_non_blank = v

    if not is_blank(source_value):
        last_non_blank = source_value
    # Write only within the specified answer_position.
    ws.cell(row=r, column=min_col).value = last_non_blank

# Save to the required output path.
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: reopen both workbooks and check target values/types/count and outside changes.

out_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)

out_ws = out_wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in out_wb.sheetnames else out_wb.active

max_c = max(orig_ws.max_column, out_ws.max_column)
